title: Check assets are still there
summary: Record that an asset was seen, and list the ones not seen since a date.

steps.text: Scan or type an asset's {tag} and choose {rec} to record that it was seen today.
Under {title}, pick a date for the assets {since} it, ready to print and look for.
You can also ask the assistant to record that an asset was seen, or which assets have not been seen since a date. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
